resources.string: 👉 Add items and manage them with simple swipes: right — delete, left — mark as purchased
✏️ Tap an item to edit its name, quantity, or unit of measurement
👆 Hold an item to select several at once — you can delete or copy them
💡 Purchased items automatically move to the bottom of the list
🔗 You can now share your list via link or a collaborative editing link
🍇 Fruit collection is here! Unlocked and selected fruits will appear when creating a list
🛒 New add-product screen that saves your input and sorts items by the number of times added
🎤 Voice input: add products using your voice
